# Building inventory

3835 building footprints, plus 5 elevated station models in the transport collection. Includes scenery buffers and set-back buildings; this is not a count of visually verified facades. Serials are ordered by road-facing frontage. Stable IDs remain unchanged when serials change. Names are map-derived unless separately verified; unidentified buildings stay unsigned. Occupant pins attach only to a containing footprint.
